    *   Marcus is free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:00-16:00.

*   **Wednesday, Nov 18:**
    *   Priya is free: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00.
    *   Marcus is free: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00.
    *   Common availability: 15:00-16:00.

*   **Thursday, Nov 19:**
    *   Priya is free: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30.
    *   Marcus is free: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30.
    *   Common availability: 10:00-10:30.

*   **Friday, Nov 20:**
    *   Priya is free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30.
    *   Marcus is free: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00.
    *   Common availability: 11:00-12:00.

I have a clear list of available slots for Priya and Marcus. I will now post this to the shared workspace so Brad can check the availability of Elena Soto and David Okafor against these times. This is the most effective way to collaborate and find a time that works for all four partners. I'll format the message clearly so he knows exactly which slots to check. </SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
